selection: Clear everyday requests; no contradictory/revoked constraints. Topics and labels fixed before inference. No filtering by model predictions.
source: Assistant-authored synthetic data; not a real-user sample and not independently human annotated.
length_scope: Short and medium English requests. Does not establish long-document performance.
limitation: Some phrasing templates are shared. Author was aware of previous development findings; new to this frozen evaluation, not independent of all prior design knowledge.
expected_label_definition: Global constraints only; exact extraction compares unordered type/value/unit tuples. A range is a minimum and maximum pair. Absence is null. Local constraints and source-text numbers are excluded.
